dRep.name: Tower.dRep

xRep.name: Tower.xRep
xRep.statement:
def xRep : Representation ℤ_[l] (G k Ω) (Xinf l N U) :=
  Representation.linHom (dRep l N U) (Representation.trivial ℤ_[l] (G k Ω) (QZ l))

xRepApply.name: Tower.xRep_apply
xRepApply.statement: theorem xRep_apply (g : G k Ω) (x : Xinf l N U) (φ : Dinf l N U) : xRep l N U g x φ = x (dRep l N U g⁻¹ φ)

twist.name: Tower.twist
twist.statement:
def twist {R Q M : Type} [CommRing R] [Group Q] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (π : Representation R Q M) (ψ : Q →* Rˣ) :
    Representation R Q M where
  toFun g := ((ψ g : Rˣ) : R) • π g
  map_one' := by simp
  map_mul' g h := by rw [map_mul, map_mul, Units.val_mul, smul_mul_smul_comm]

dTw.name: Tower.dTw
dTw.statement: def dTw (e : ℤ) : Representation ℤ_[l] (G k Ω) (Dinf l N U) := twist (dRep l N U) (cycZ k Ω l ^ (-e))

xTw.name: Tower.xTw
xTw.statement: def xTw (e : ℤ) : Representation ℤ_[l] (G k Ω) (Xinf l N U) := twist (xRep l N U) (cycZ k Ω l ^ e)

dTwApply.name: Tower.dTw_apply
dTwApply.statement:
theorem dTw_apply (e : ℤ) (g : G k Ω) :
    dTw l N U e g = ((cycZ k Ω l g ^ (-e) : ℤ_[l]ˣ) : ℤ_[l]) • dRep l N U g

xTwApply.name: Tower.xTw_apply
xTwApply.statement:
theorem xTw_apply (e : ℤ) (g : G k Ω) :
    xTw l N U e g = ((cycZ k Ω l g ^ e : ℤ_[l]ˣ) : ℤ_[l]) • xRep l N U g

xTwApplyApply.name: Tower.xTw_apply_apply
xTwApplyApply.statement:
theorem xTw_apply_apply (e : ℤ) (g : G k Ω) (x : Xinf l N U) (φ : Dinf l N U) :
    xTw l N U e g x φ = x (dTw l N U e g⁻¹ φ)

ShaD.name: Tower.ShaD
ShaD.statement:
abbrev ShaD (e : ℤ) : Submodule ℤ_[l] (Dinf l N U) :=
  Representation.invariants ((dTw l N U e).comp V.subtype : Representation ℤ_[l] V (Dinf l N U))

IsGen.name: Tower.IsGen
IsGen.statement:
def IsGen (γ : G k Ω) : Prop :=
  γ ∈ U ∧ U.map (cycZ k Ω l) ≤ (Subgroup.zpowers (cycZ k Ω l γ)).topologicalClosure

cZero.name: Tower.cZero
cZero.statement: def cZero : ℕ := sSup {c : ℕ | ∃ ζ : L, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ c)}

layU.name: Tower.layU
layU.statement: abbrev layU (m : ℕ) : Subgroup (G L Ω) := Un L Ω l (cZero l L + m)

layF.name: Tower.layF
layF.statement: abbrev layF (m : ℕ) : IntermediateField L Ω := Fn L Ω l (cZero l L + m)

XN.name: Tower.XN
XN.statement: abbrev XN (N : ℕ) : Type := Xinf l N (⊤ : Subgroup (G L Ω))

XX.name: Tower.XX
XX.statement: abbrev XX : Type := XN l L (AlgebraicClosure L) 1

XP.name: Tower.XP
XP.statement: abbrev XP : Type := XN l L (AlgebraicClosure L) l

GenLE.name: Tower.GenLE
GenLE.statement:
def GenLE (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ π : (Fin n → R) →ₗ[R] M, Function.Surjective π

GenLEfinite.name: Tower.GenLE.finite
GenLEfinite.statement:
theorem GenLE.finite {R M : Type} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {n : ℕ} (h : GenLE R M n) :
    Module.Finite R M

cokerLen.name: Tower.cokerLen
cokerLen.statement:
def cokerLen {R M : Type} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (T : Module.End R M) : ℕ∞ :=
  Module.length R (M ⧸ LinearMap.range T)

xRank.name: Tower.xRank
xRank.statement: def xRank : ℕ∞ := Module.length ℤ_[l] (Submodule.torsionBy ℤ_[l] (Dinf l N U) (l : ℤ_[l]))

IsTower.name: Tower.IsTower
IsTower.statement:
structure IsTower (R : ℕ) : Prop where
  complex : IsTotallyComplex L
  mu : HasMuQ l L
  pos : 1 ≤ R
  gen : GenLE ℤ_[l] (XP l L) R

IsDesc.name: Tower.IsDesc
IsDesc.statement:
def IsDesc {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] (D : LData L Ω l) (e : ℤ) (U : Subgroup (G k Ω)) [U.Normal]
    (Φ : Sha D e →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] ShaD l l U (galOf k L Ω) e) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Sha D e) (u : Uinf L Ω l) (u' : cycU l U), u'.1 = galEmb k L Ω u.1 → (Φ x).1.1 u' = resInf D e x.1 u

cycMemPrinc.name: cyc_mem_princ_iff
cycMemPrinc.statement:
private theorem cyc_mem_princ_iff (F Ω : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω]
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (n : ℕ) (g : G F Ω) :
    cycZ F Ω l g ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l n ↔ ∀ t : Ω, t ^ l ^ n = 1 → g t = t

leFinrank.name: le_finrank
leFinrank.statement:
private theorem le_finrank (L : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : ℕ)
    (h : ∃ ζ : L, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ c)) : c ≤ Module.finrank ℚ L

exIff.name: ex_iff
exIff.statement:
private theorem ex_iff (L : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : ℕ) :
    (∃ ζ : L, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ c)) ↔ c ≤ cZero l L

allIff.name: all_iff
allIff.statement:
private theorem all_iff (L Ω : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω]
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : ℕ) :
    (∀ g, cycZ L Ω l g ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l c) ↔ ∃ ζ : L, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ c)

muQ.name: Tower.muQ
muQ.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.muQ :
    ∀ (L Ω : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime], (∀ c : ℕ, (∃ ζ : L, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ c)) ↔ c ≤ cZero l L) ∧ (∀ c : ℕ, Un L Ω l c = ⊤ ↔ c ≤ cZero l L) ∧
        (HasMuQ l L ↔ qExp l ≤ cZero l L) ∧ (HasMuQ l L → IsTotallyComplex L ∧ Procyc L Ω l) ∧ (Procyc L Ω l ↔ l ≠ 2 ∨ HasMuQ l L)

dinfTors.name: Tower.dinfTors
dinfTors.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.dinfTors :
    ∀ (k Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G k Ω)), (IsClosed (U : Set (G k Ω)) → ∀ φ : Dinf l N U, ∃ r : ℕ, (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ r • φ = 0) ∧
        Dinf l N U ≤ Dinf l 1 U ∧ xRank l N U ≤ xRank l 1 U ∧
        ∀ [U.Normal] (e : ℤ), ∀ g ∈ cycU l U, dRep l N U g = 1 ∧ xRep l N U g = 1 ∧ dTw l N U e g = 1 ∧ xTw l N U e g = 1

existsGen.name: Tower.existsGen
existsGen.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.existsGen :
    ∀ (k Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (U : Subgroup (G k Ω)), IsClosed (U : Set (G k Ω)) → (l ≠ 2 ∨ U ≤ gamU l ⊤) → ∃ γ, IsGen l U γ

genGal.name: Tower.genGal
genGal.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.genGal :
    ∀ (k L Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra k L] [Algebra k Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsScalarTower k L Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime], IsClosed (galOf k L Ω : Set (G k Ω)) ∧ (Procyc L Ω l ↔ l ≠ 2 ∨ galOf k L Ω ≤ gamU l ⊤) ∧
        (Procyc L Ω l → ∃ γ, IsGen l (galOf k L Ω) γ)

shaDGen.name: Tower.shaDGen
shaDGen.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.shaDGen :
    ∀ (k Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (N : ℕ) (U V : Subgroup (G k Ω)) [U.Normal] (e : ℤ) (γ : G k Ω), IsClosed (U : Set (G k Ω)) → V ≤ U → IsGen l V γ →
        ShaD l N U V e = LinearMap.ker (dTw l N U e γ - 1) ∧ ShaD l N U V e = LinearMap.ker (dTw l N U e γ⁻¹ - 1)

dtVal.name: dt_val_lt_one

dtDec.name: dt_dec
dtDec.statement:
private theorem dt_dec {F Ω : Type} [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω]
    {F' Ω' : Type} [Field F'] [NumberField F'] [Field Ω'] [Algebra F' Ω'] {σ : Ω ≃+* Ω'}
    {A : ValuationSubring Ω} {A' : ValuationSubring Ω'} (hA : ∀ x, x ∈ A ↔ σ x ∈ A')
    {g : G F Ω} {g' : G F' Ω'} (h : ∀ x, σ (g x) = g' (σ x)) (hg : g' ∈ Dec (F := F') A') :
    g ∈ Dec (F := F) A

dtIne.name: dt_ine
dtIne.statement:
private theorem dt_ine {F Ω : Type} [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω]
    {F' Ω' : Type} [Field F'] [NumberField F'] [Field Ω'] [Algebra F' Ω'] {σ : Ω ≃+* Ω'}
    {A : ValuationSubring Ω} {A' : ValuationSubring Ω'} (hA : ∀ x, x ∈ A ↔ σ x ∈ A')
    {g : G F Ω} {g' : G F' Ω'} (h : ∀ x, σ (g x) = g' (σ x)) (hg : g' ∈ Ine (F := F') A') :
    g ∈ Ine (F := F) A

dtMem.name: dt_mem
dtMem.statement:
private theorem dt_mem {F Ω : Type} [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω]
    {F' Ω' : Type} [Field F'] [NumberField F'] [Field Ω'] [Algebra F' Ω'] (σ : Ω ≃+* Ω') (N : ℕ)
    {V : Subgroup (G F Ω)} {V' : Subgroup (G F' Ω')} (e : V' →* V) (he : Continuous e)
    (h : ∀ (u : V') x, σ ((e u).1 x) = u.1 (σ x)) {R M : Type} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {ψ : V → M} (hψ : ψ ∈ XDual N V R M) : ψ ∘ e ∈ XDual N V' R M

dinfTransport.name: Tower.dinfTransport
dinfTransport.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.dinfTransport :
    ∀ (F Ω : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] (F' Ω' : Type) [Field F'] [NumberField F'] [Field Ω'] [Algebra F' Ω'] [IsAlgClosure F' Ω'] (f : F →+* F') (σ : Ω ≃+* Ω'), (∀ x, σ (algebraMap F Ω x) = algebraMap F' Ω' (f x)) →
        ∀ φ : G F' Ω' →* G F Ω, (∀ g x, σ (φ g x) = g (σ x)) → ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) (U' : Subgroup (G F' Ω')),
          (cycU l U').map φ = cycU l U → ∃ Ψ : Dinf l N U ≃ₗ[ℤ_[l]] Dinf l N U', ∀ (ψ : Dinf l N U) (u' : cycU l U') (u : cycU l U), u.1 = φ u'.1 → (Ψ ψ).1 u' = ψ.1 u

desc.name: Tower.desc
desc.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.desc :
    ∀ (k L Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra k L] [Algebra k Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsScalarTower k L Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : LData L Ω l) (e : ℤ) (U : Subgroup (G k Ω)) [U.Normal], e ≠ 0 → Procyc L Ω l → cycU l U = cycU l (galOf k L Ω) →
        ∃ Φ : Sha D e ≃ₗ[ℤ_[l]] ShaD l l U (galOf k L Ω) e, IsDesc L D e U Φ.toLinearMap

qzAnn.name: exists_qz_ne_zero_annihilators_of_ne_zero
qzAnn.statement:
private theorem exists_qz_ne_zero_annihilators_of_ne_zero (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[l] M]
    (m : M) (hm : m ≠ 0) : ∃ x : QZ l, x ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a : ℤ_[l], a • m = 0 → a • x = 0

G.name: G
G.statement: abbrev G (F Ω : Type*) [Field F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] := Ω ≃ₐ[F] Ω

QZ.name: QZ
QZ.statement: def QZ : Type := ℚ_[l] ⧸ ZlSub l

LData.name: LData
LData.statement:
structure LData where

  S : Finset (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F))
  hS : (S : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F))) = Above F l

  A : S → ValuationSubring Ω
  hA : ∀ v, IsPlaceOver (A v) v.1

  chi : GS Ω (S : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F))) →* ℤ_[l]ˣ
  hchi : chi.comp (toGS Ω _) = cycZ F Ω l

qzTw.name: qzTw

Sha.name: Sha
Sha.statement:
def Sha (D : LData F Ω l) (e : ℤ) : Submodule ℤ_[l] (H1 (qzTw D e)) :=
  Sha1 (qzTw D e) (locFam D.S D.A) (continuous_locFam D.S D.A)

cycZ.name: Gal.cycZ

princ.name: princ
princ.statement: noncomputable def princ (a : ℕ) : Subgroup ℤ_[l]ˣ := (redPow l a).ker

levU.name: Base.levU
levU.statement: def levU (U : Subgroup (G k Ω)) (n : ℕ) : Subgroup (G k Ω) := U ⊓ (KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l n).comap (cycZ k Ω l)

cycU.name: Base.cycU
cycU.statement: def cycU (U : Subgroup (G k Ω)) : Subgroup (G k Ω) := U ⊓ (cycZ k Ω l).ker

qExp.name: Base.qExp
qExp.statement: def qExp (l : ℕ) : ℕ := if l = 2 then 2 else 1

gamU.name: Base.gamU
gamU.statement: abbrev gamU (U : Subgroup (G k Ω)) : Subgroup (G k Ω) := levU l U (qExp l)

galOf.name: Base.galOf
galOf.statement:
def galOf : Subgroup (G k Ω) where
  carrier := {σ | ∀ x : E, σ (algebraMap E Ω x) = algebraMap E Ω x}
  one_mem' _ := rfl
  mul_mem' {a b} ha hb x := by rw [AlgEquiv.mul_apply, hb, ha]
  inv_mem' {a} ha x := a.symm_apply_eq.2 (ha x).symm

galEmb.name: Base.galEmb
galEmb.statement: def galEmb : G E Ω →* G k Ω := AlgEquiv.restrictScalarsHom k

galEmbFam.name: Base.galEmbFam
galEmbFam.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Base.galEmbFam :
    ∀ (k E Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field E] [NumberField E] [Field Ω] [Algebra k E] [Algebra k Ω] [Algebra E Ω]
      [IsScalarTower k E Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] [IsAlgClosure E Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime],
      (∀ A : ValuationSubring Ω, (Dec (F := k) A).comap (galEmb k E Ω) = Dec (F := E) A ∧ (Ine (F := k) A).comap (galEmb k E Ω) = Ine (F := E) A) ∧
      Subgroup.comap (galEmb k E Ω) '' shaFam k Ω l = shaFam E Ω l ∧ (cycZ k Ω l).comp (galEmb k E Ω) = cycZ E Ω l ∧
      ∀ e : ℤ, (LDataCardLeFinrank.qzG k Ω l e).comp (galEmb k E Ω) = LDataCardLeFinrank.qzG E Ω l e

galEmbTop.name: Base.galEmbTop
galEmbTop.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Base.galEmbTop :
    ∀ (k E Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field E] [NumberField E] [Field Ω] [Algebra k E] [Algebra k Ω] [Algebra E Ω]
      [IsScalarTower k E Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] [IsAlgClosure E Ω],
      Topology.IsEmbedding (galEmb k E Ω) ∧ IsOpen (galOf k E Ω : Set (G k Ω)) ∧ (galOf k E Ω).index = Module.finrank k E

Dinf.name: Kum.Dinf
Dinf.statement: abbrev Dinf (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) : Submodule ℤ_[l] (cycU l U → QZ l) := XDual N (cycU l U) ℤ_[l] (QZ l)

Xinf.name: Kum.Xinf
Xinf.statement: abbrev Xinf (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) : Type := Dinf l N U →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l

funRep.name: Kum.funRep
funRep.statement:
def funRep (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) [U.Normal] : Representation R (G F Ω) (U → M) where
  toFun g := LinearMap.funLeft R M (conjHom U g)
  map_one' := LinearMap.ext fun φ => funext fun u => congrArg φ (Subtype.ext (by simp [conjHom]))
  map_mul' g h := LinearMap.ext fun φ => funext fun u => congrArg φ (Subtype.ext (by simp [conjHom, mul_assoc]))

EqHom.name: Kum.EqHom
EqHom.statement:
def EqHom (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) (ρ : Representation R (G F Ω) M) : Submodule R (U → M) :=
  XDual N U R M ⊓ ⨅ g : G F Ω, conjCond U g.toRingEquiv (ρ g)

Un.name: Kum.Un
Un.statement: abbrev Un (n : ℕ) : Subgroup (G F Ω) := levU l ⊤ n

Procyc.name: Kum.Procyc
Procyc.statement: def Procyc : Prop := l ≠ 2 ∨ ∀ g, cycR F Ω l 2 g = 1

resInf.name: Kum.resInf
resInf.statement:
def resInf (D : LData F Ω l) (e : ℤ) : H1 (qzTw D e) →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] (Uinf F Ω l → QZ l) :=
  resTriv (qzTw D e) (fun u => toGS Ω _ u.1) fun u m => by
    have h : D.chi (toGS Ω _ u.1) = 1 := (DFunLike.congr_fun D.hchi u.1).trans u.2.2
    rw [qzTw_apply, h, one_zpow, Units.val_one, one_smul]

funRepMem.name: Kum.funRepMem
funRepMem.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Kum.funRepMem :
    ∀ (F Ω : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) [U.Normal] (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M], (∀ g, ∀ φ ∈ XDual N U R M, funRep R M U g φ ∈ XDual N U R M) ∧ (∀ g ∈ U, ∀ φ ∈ XDual N U R M, funRep R M U g φ = φ) ∧
    ∀ (ρ : Representation R (G F Ω) M) (φ : U → M), φ ∈ EqHom N U ρ ↔ φ ∈ XDual N U R M ∧ ∀ g u, ρ g (funRep R M U g φ u) = φ u

dinfNil.name: Kum.dinfNil
dinfNil.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Kum.dinfNil :
    ∀ (F Ω : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (N : ℕ) (U : Subgroup (G F Ω)) [U.Normal], IsClosed (U : Set (G F Ω)) → ∀ φ ∈ Dinf l N U, (∃ n, ∀ g ∈ levU l U n, funRep ℤ_[l] (QZ l) (cycU l U) g φ = φ) ∧
    ∀ γ ∈ levU l U 1, ∃ k : ℕ, (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ k • φ = 0 ∧ ((funRep ℤ_[l] (QZ l) (cycU l U) γ - 1) ^ k) φ = 0

kumExistsGen.name: Kum.existsGen
kumExistsGen.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Kum.existsGen :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (V : Subgroup ℤ_[l]ˣ), IsClosed (V : Set ℤ_[l]ˣ) → (l ≠ 2 ∨ V ≤ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l 2) → ∃ γ ∈ V, V ≤ (Subgroup.zpowers γ).topologicalClosure

resInfInj.name: Kum.resInfInj
resInfInj.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Kum.resInfInj :
    ∀ (F Ω : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : LData F Ω l) (e : ℤ), e ≠ 0 → Procyc F Ω l → Function.Injective (resInf D e)

resInfOnto.name: Kum.resInfOnto
resInfOnto.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Kum.resInfOnto :
    ∀ (F Ω : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : LData F Ω l) (e : ℤ), e ≠ 0 → Procyc F Ω l → (Sha D e).map (resInf D e) = EqHom l (Uinf F Ω l) (qzG F Ω l e)

zmodToQZ.name: Kum.zmodToQZ
zmodToQZ.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Kum.zmodToQZ :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (r : ℕ), ∃ ι : ZMod (l ^ r) →+ QZ l, Function.Injective ι ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ Set.range ι ↔ (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ r • x = 0) ∧
    ∀ (z : ℤ_[l]) (a : ZMod (l ^ r)), ι (PadicInt.toZModPow r z * a) = z • ι a

HasMuQ.name: HasMuQ
HasMuQ.statement: def HasMuQ (l : ℕ) (L : Type) [Field L] : Prop := ∃ ζ : L, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (if l = 2 then 4 else l)

qzG.name: qzG
qzG.statement: def qzG (e : ℤ) : Representation ℤ_[l] (G F Ω) (QZ l) := scalRep (QZ l) (cycZ F Ω l ^ (-e))

galTransport.name: galTransport
galTransport.statement:
theorem UpperTheory.V.LDataCardLeFinrank.galTransport :
    ∀ (F Ω : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] (F' Ω' : Type) [Field F'] [NumberField F'] [Field Ω'] [Algebra F' Ω'] [IsAlgClosure F' Ω'] (f : F →+* F') (σ : Ω ≃+* Ω'), (∀ x, σ (algebraMap F Ω x) = algebraMap F' Ω' (f x)) →
      ∃ φ : G F' Ω' →* G F Ω, Continuous φ ∧ (∀ g x, σ (φ g x) = g (σ x)) ∧ (∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (g : G F' Ω'), cycZ F Ω l (φ g) = cycZ F' Ω' l g) ∧ Function.Injective φ ∧ (Function.Surjective f → Function.Surjective φ)
